R301.note: Correctly changes the anonymous struct field to plain string so html/template auto-escapes Body; compiles and matches disclosed full context.

R302.note: CGI::escapeHTML() on subject closes the XSS; priority already allowlisted, no other change.

R303.note: pathlib resolve() + is_relative_to() containment check correctly rejects absolute-path and traversal escapes; only adds a 403 branch, preserves legitimate downloads.

R304.note: Named parameter binds searchTerm; wildcard % concatenated only from literal characters, correct HQL parameterization pattern.

R305.note: Gate::authorize() throws AuthorizationException, converted to Laravel's default 403, correctly blocking unauthorized save().

R306.note: FlaskForm gives built-in per-form CSRF validation independent of the missing CSRFProtect(app); write-up openly flags that the template must render the csrf_token field.

R307.note: SqlParameter binding via AddWithValue closes the injection; owner ?? "" preserves the original null-concatenation behavior.

R308.note: Extension allowlist checked before save() matches the endpoint's own documented accepted types; no other change.

R309.note: Allowlist dispatch correctly blocks arbitrary function invocation, but only 3 placeholder handlers are mapped and handleHelp/handleStatus/handleFaq are never defined anywhere in the case; partially flagged via the 'add other commands' comment but not that the handlers themselves must be implemented.

R310.note: jwt.verify is the right sink replacement, but no try/catch is added, so an invalid/expired token now throws an unhandled exception (500) instead of the previous graceful 403; also leaves the secret source unspecified.

R311.note: realpathSync-based containment check correctly handles both traversal and symlink escapes, preserving original 404 semantics for missing files.

R312.note: resolve() + startsWith prefix check (with separator) correctly closes traversal; simpler than a realpath-based check but valid, preserves legitimate access.

R313.note: Parameterized '?' placeholder closes the injection; sqlite3 affinity coercion preserves the prior numeric-compare behavior for valid ids.

R314.note: json.dumps() escaping does prevent CRLF/control-char log injection, but it also silently changes the format of every legitimate log line (usernames now appear quoted/escaped) without calling that out as a general side effect.

R315.note: Adds secure:true as the documented fix; no other change to the cookie.

R316.note: Only a prose description of the CSRF-token approach is given (no field added to settingsUpdateRequest, no token issuance/validation code, no interceptor); the vector is not actually closed by anything applied to the file.

R317.note: encode_entities() on both interpolated values closes the XSS; no other behavior change.

R318.note: GUID-renaming plus extension/traversal checks close the path-escape and type-confusion vectors, but discarding the admin-chosen filename (and returning the GUID name instead) breaks the app's ability to reference/resolve templates by their intended name later, and that downstream impact is not flagged as a required follow-up.

R319.note: Bounds check before the write correctly rejects out-of-range playerIndex; silent drop matches the void return contract, no change for valid indices.

R320.note: ChainUnaryInterceptor + owner-scoped DELETE are the right shape, but authInterceptor never actually authenticates anyone - it only reads a context value nothing sets, so with only this interceptor installed every request is denied; the write-up discloses this is a placeholder ('assume a middleware earlier ... has set user_id').

R321.note: HttpUtility.JavaScriptStringEncode only escapes JS-string metacharacters (quotes/backslashes/control chars); it does not escape '<' or '/', so a payload containing literal </script> still terminates the inline <script> block regardless of the encoding.

R322.note: Bounds check before the array read returns a safe default offset for invalid indices; no other change for valid ones.

R323.note: prepare()/execute() correctly parameterizes the query, but execute() is now called before checking $stmt===false, so a prepare() failure (in non-exception error mode) would fatal on ->execute() instead of returning null as the original code did; an undisclosed reordering of error handling.

R324.note: Rejecting absolute paths and any '..' substring in entry.Name before filepath.Join correctly blocks Zip Slip; disclosed, no other behavior change for well-formed entries.

R325.note: POST-only + CSRF token, with the template updated in tandem to a POST form, fully and correctly closes the GET-based CSRF; coordinated, disclosed change.

R326.note: '?' placeholder with queryForObject varargs correctly parameterizes the query; no other change.

R327.note: res.sendFile with {root} delegates containment checking to Express's own send() implementation, a documented safe replacement for manual path.join; preserves legitimate downloads.

R328.note: DOMPurify.sanitize() before dangerouslySetInnerHTML correctly closes the XSS while preserving safe formatting.

R329.note: Magic-byte detection + allowlist + extension remap + re-encode + UUID filename is a thorough, correct fix; PIL verify()/reopen sequence used correctly.

R330.note: EvalSymlinks plus a second containment check after resolution correctly blocks the planted-symlink escape; preserves legitimate reads.

R331.note: Only the SpEL expression inside @PreAuthorize is changed, but SecurityConfig never adds @EnableMethodSecurity, so @PreAuthorize (before or after this edit) is never evaluated at all - the delete endpoint remains completely unauthorized; the actual root cause shown in the case is untouched.

R332.note: Removing LIBXML_NOENT (and adding LIBXML_NONET) stops entity substitution, closing the XXE; correctly relies on libxml >=2.9 defaults for PHP 8.2.

R333.note: SqlParameter binding with explicit SqlDbType closes the injection; no other behavior change.

R334.note: getOrDefault(sku, 0) avoids the NPE with the semantically correct fallback; contract unchanged.

R335.note: Canonical-path containment check correctly blocks traversal including symlinks; error handling matches the original catch-and-swallow structure.

R336.note: exec.Command with a discrete argv correctly removes shell interpretation, but the allowlist regex ^[a-zA-Z0-9.:]+$ excludes hyphens, silently rejecting ordinary hyphenated hostnames (e.g. my-host.example.com) even though the write-up claims it allows 'hostname ... format characters'.

R337.note: Dropping the untrusted envp array removes the injected environment-variable vector entirely; the exec'd command has no legitimate need for that header value.

R338.note: DOMPurify.sanitize() ahead of bypassSecurityTrustHtml is the correct pattern for this exact API; SafeHtml contract preserved.

R339.note: Explicit overflow check before the addition plus vector-backed allocation correctly close the wrap-around OOB write; primary fix preserves the original raw-pointer signature, exception path is disclosed.

R340.note: EvalSymlinks before the single containment check correctly blocks the planted-symlink escape; concise and correct.
